title: Long-form Blog Post Generator
description: Generate a comprehensive, SEO-optimized blog post with proper structure, headings, and keyword integration.
description_cn: 生成一篇结构完整、SEO优化的长篇博客文章，包含合理的标题层次和关键词布局。
prompt: You are an expert content strategist and blog writer with 15 years of experience. Write a comprehensive blog post on the following topic. Structure it with: 1) A compelling H1 title with primary keyword, 2) An engaging introduction that hooks the reader, 3) H2 and H3 subheadings that create a logical flow, 4) Body paragraphs with data, examples, and actionable insights, 5) A conclusion with a call-to-action. Use the target keyword naturally 3-5 times. Write in a [TONE: professional/conversational/technical] voice. Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Word count: [1500-3000]. Topic: [TOPIC]
prompt_cn: 你是一位拥有15年经验的内容策略师和博客撰稿人。请就以下主题撰写一篇全面的博客文章。结构如下：1) 包含主要关键词的吸引人H1标题，2) 能抓住读者的引人入胜的开头，3) 逻辑清晰的H2和H3小标题，4) 包含数据、案例和可操作见解的正文段落，5) 带有行动号召的结尾。自然地使用目标关键词3-5次。以[语气：专业/对话式/技术性]的风格写作。目标读者：[读者群体]。字数：[1500-3000]。主题：[主题]
example_usage: Write a 2000-word blog post about 'The Future of Remote Work in 2026' targeting tech managers, professional tone.
best_practices: Provide the keyword list upfront. Specify whether you want statistics included. For best SEO results, mention LSI keywords.

title: Persuasive Sales Copy Generator
title_cn: 说服力销售文案生成器
description: Create high-conversion sales copy using proven frameworks like AIDA, PAS, or before-after-bridge.
description_cn: 使用AIDA、PAS等经典框架生成高转化率的销售文案。
prompt: You are a world-class direct response copywriter. Using the [FRAMEWORK: AIDA / PAS / Before-After-Bridge] framework, write persuasive sales copy for the following product or service. Product: [PRODUCT]. Key benefits: [BENEFITS]. Unique selling proposition: [USP]. Target audience pain point: [PAIN]. Desired action: [CTA]. The copy should address objections preemptively and create urgency. Include: headline, subheadline, body copy, bullet points of benefits, social proof placeholder, guarantee statement, and call-to-action.
prompt_cn: 你是一位世界级的直销文案。使用[框架：AIDA / PAS / 前-后-桥]框架，为以下产品或服务撰写有说服力的销售文案。产品：[产品]。核心卖点：[卖点]。独特价值主张：[USP]。目标用户痛点：[痛点]。期望行动：[行动号召]。文案应预先回应潜在异议并创造紧迫感。包含：标题、副标题、正文、卖点列表、社会证明占位符、保证声明和行动号召。
example_usage: Write AIDA-style sales page for a $49 AI writing tool targeting freelance writers, pain point: writer's block.
best_practices: Specify the exact framework and target CTA. Include competitor names if you want comparison angles.

title: Email Newsletter Writer
description: Craft engaging email newsletters that drive opens, clicks, and reader loyalty.
description_cn: 撰写能提高打开率、点击率和读者忠诚度的邮件通讯。
prompt: You are an email marketing specialist. Write a newsletter email for [AUDIENCE] about [TOPIC]. Structure: 1) Subject line (3 variants, under 50 chars each), 2) Preview text that complements the subject, 3) Warm, personal greeting, 4) Hook paragraph that delivers on the subject line promise, 5) Main content (1-2 key insights or stories), 6) Soft pitch or link to your offer, 7) P.S. with extra value. Tone: [TONE]. Keep it under 400 words. Make it feel like a personal email from a friend, not a corporate blast.
prompt_cn: 你是一位邮件营销专家。为[目标读者]撰写一封关于[主题]的通讯邮件。结构：1) 邮件主题（3个变体，每个50字以内），2) 配合主题的预览文本，3) 温暖亲切的问候语，4) 兑现主题承诺的钩子段落，5) 主要内容（1-2个关键见解或故事），6) 软性推销或链接到你的产品，7) 附带额外价值的附言。语气：[语气]。控制在400字以内。要像朋友发的个人邮件，而非公司群发。
example_usage: Write a newsletter for SaaS founders about '3 AI trends reshaping product development', casual yet insightful tone.
best_practices: Always request multiple subject line variants. Specify the primary goal (click/open/forward).

title: Social Media Content Calendar
description: Generate a full week/month of social media posts with captions, hashtags, and visual suggestions.
description_cn: 生成一周或一个月的社交媒体帖子，包含文案、标签和视觉建议。
prompt: You are a social media strategist. Create a [TIMEFRAME: weekly/monthly] content calendar for [PLATFORM: Instagram/Twitter/LinkedIn/TikTok] targeting [AUDIENCE] in the [INDUSTRY] niche. For each day, provide: Post type (educational/entertaining/promotional/behind-the-scenes), caption (with emoji suggestions), relevant hashtags (5-10), best posting time, visual/image concept, and engagement hook. Brand voice: [VOICE]. Include content pillars: [PILLARS]. Follow the 80/20 rule (80% value, 20% promotion).
prompt_cn: 你是一位社交媒体策略师。为[平台：Instagram/Twitter/LinkedIn/TikTok]创建一个[时间：每周/每月]内容日历，目标受众是[行业]领域的[目标用户]。每天提供：帖子类型（教育/娱乐/推广/幕后），文案（含emoji建议），相关话题标签（5-10个），最佳发布时间，视觉/图片概念，以及互动钩子。品牌语调：[语调]。包含内容支柱：[支柱]。遵循80/20法则（80%价值内容，20%推广内容）。
example_usage: Create a weekly Instagram calendar for a fitness coach targeting busy professionals, pillars: workout tips, nutrition, motivation.
best_practices: Define your content pillars clearly. Mention specific holidays or events you want to align with.

title: Technical Documentation Writer
description: Write clear, comprehensive technical documentation including API docs, READMEs, and user guides.
description_cn: 编写清晰全面的技术文档，包括API文档、README和用户指南。
prompt: You are a senior technical writer who makes complex systems simple. Write [TYPE: API documentation / README / user guide / onboarding tutorial] for [PRODUCT/FEATURE]. Follow these principles: 1) Start with what problem this solves in one sentence, 2) Provide a quick-start section with copy-paste code, 3) Document every parameter/option with type, default, and example, 4) Include error messages and troubleshooting, 5) Use consistent terminology throughout. Code examples must be in [LANGUAGE]. Target reader: [BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED].
prompt_cn: 你是一位能让复杂系统变得简单易懂的资深技术文档撰写人。为[产品/功能]编写[类型：API文档/README/用户指南/入门教程]。遵循以下原则：1) 用一句话说明解决什么问题，2) 提供可复制粘贴代码的快速入门部分，3) 记录每个参数/选项的类型、默认值和示例，4) 包含错误信息和故障排除，5) 全文使用一致的术语。代码示例使用[语言]。目标读者：[初级/中级/高级]。
example_usage: Write API documentation for a REST endpoint POST /api/v1/users with authentication, targeting intermediate developers.
best_practices: Provide the API spec or function signature. Mention if you need OpenAPI/Swagger format.
